title: Can a Spot Urine Replace or Improve 24 Hour Urine Collections in Kidney Stone Patients
brief_summary: This study will sought to determine if limited urine collections can provide similar or more informative data than standard 24-hour urine collections used to evaluate kidney stone formers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have been diagnosed as having calcium based urinary stones
* at least 19 years of age
* do not have any additional serious disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not have calcium based urinary stones (such as: uric acid, cystine, struvite)
* less than 19 years of age
* have a serious alternate disease
* Pregnancy
* Positive Urine Culture
* Active cancer
* Recurrent urinary infections
* Gross hematuria
* Receiving treatment with thiazides (or alternatively can be enrolled if the patient is willing to stop treatment for 2 weeks prior to study)
* Inability to provide informed consent
* Investigator's refusal to include
study_population: Patients receiving care at Vancouver General Hospital for their kidney stone disease.
